Beauty, Artistry & Confidence

Our Story

The Beauti Studio has been serving clients in Perth since 2018, specialising in enhancing natural beauty through cosmetic tattooing and advanced beauty treatments. What began as a passion for precision and artistry has grown into a trusted destination inside Westfield Carousel.

Every treatment is approached with the same philosophy: enhance, don't overpower. We take the time to understand your features, your lifestyle and the look you want, then bring it to life with a steady hand and an artist's eye.

Our team is fully trained and certified in cosmetic tattooing, skin needling and advanced beauty techniques, with ongoing education to stay at the forefront of the industry.
